No repurchases were executed in the quarter ended Aug. 30, 2026, including open‑market or negotiated purchases.
Equity withholdings to satisfy tax obligations on deferred option unit distributions are included in repurchase totals.
No directors or officers adopted or terminated Rule 10b5‑1 or non‑Rule 10b5‑1 trading plans during the quarter.
